lead: AB de Villiers is a widely followed South African cricketer, born on 17 February 1984 in Pretoria.
As of 2026, he is 42 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Delhi Capitals.
This profile collects the AB facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

paras: AB de Villiers was born on 17 February 1984 in Pretoria, and holds South African nationality.

sections.heading: AB de Villiers — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, AB has been associated with Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2011), Delhi Capitals (from 2008 to 2010), South Africa national cricket team (from 2004 to 2018), Northerns cricket team (from 2003), Titans cricket team (from 2004), Barbados Tridents (from 2016 to 2016) and Brisbane Heat.
